name: Bengo no Joou
source:
"Let's have you train under one of us." 
As the newest addition to a law office, you have no courtroom experience.
Who will you pair up with?
A greedy, ruthless, but capable lawyer?
An elite overachiever with a strict family background?
A playful misfit?
Or...?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.romance_games.info.queen_of_defense]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
“让你在我们其中一位的指导下训练吧。” 
作为律师事务所的最新成员，你没有法庭经验。
你会和谁配对？
一个贪婪、无情但有能力的律师？
一个有着严格家庭背景的精英优胜者？
一个顽皮的不合群的人？
或者…？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.romance_games.info.queen_of_defense]Google Play[/url]]
